$comment: Decision record (task P3.1, C12, T4.3): one analysis decision, who made it (a person or an agent), what had been seen when it was made, which artifacts it produced and which recipe it chose. 'seen' binds a prefix of the analysis's exposure record (through_seq entries and the canonical SHA-256 of exactly those entries), so the binding survives later appends and an edited history is detected. A decision record authorizes nothing; it is lineage. 1.1.0 (contracts 3.11.0, detector system design spec DEC-03..DEC-20) adds the six design categories, the 'not-applicable' seen marker and dispositions[], all only for design categories (contracts/lineage.py checks that, at least one artifact for a design category, and the input closure of a not-applicable marker); 1.0.0 records keep their meaning.

analysis.$comment: for a design record, the design_id of the design-spec (DEC-17)

through_seq.$comment: number of exposure-record entries that existed when the decision was made

entries_sha256.$comment: canonical SHA-256 of those entries (a JSON list)

anyOf.$comment: 1.1.0, design categories only (DEC-14): no blinding exposure applies; refused when the input closure holds experimental, observed, external or protected data (DEC-15)

dispositions.$comment: 1.1.0, design categories only (DEC-13): one entry per inconclusive driving requirement of a design-baseline record

recipe_sha256.$comment: canonical SHA-256 of the recipe the decision chose or ran under, when there is one
